environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed in a private subnet (10.0.128.0/20) within a VPC that has NO NAT gateway, NO VPC endpoints for external services, and NO internet gateway route in the subnet's route table. The only route table entry is the local VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16 -> local). Security group egress rules allow only port 5432 to the RDS instance within the same VPC (sg-0a3f2c... -> sg-0b7d1e... on TCP/5432). The internal ALB (scheme: internal) accepts WebSocket upgrades only from the API gateway VPC endpoint. DNS resolution for external domains returns NXDOMAIN via Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint with a forwarding rule for '.' to a blackhole. The race condition still exists in the code and can still cause negative balances, but the stolen funds cannot be exfiltrated to any external system because there is literally no network path out of the subnet.

config.vpc_endpoints: none (no S3, no ECR pull-through, images pre-cached)
